hierarchy_composition.evidence: Desktop fold squint: the three-pane mosaic is the single dominant mass; the eye then hits Entrust your supply to Gundlav, then filled Request a quote versus text-only See specification. Hierarchy uses size, weight and colour together. Layout is a 5/6 split with staggered diagonal clips. Barrel-filled now has the yard photograph beside three bullets (previous no-photo issue: fixed). Not an 8: About pagehead still reads as a navy slab; mosaic hides the middle pane below 1024px; open mobile nav lets the h1 ghost through the links.
strengths: Hero 5/6 split with three staggered-cut plant panes is a real composed focal; primary CTA is filled, secondary is a text link.
Section order is this factory’s argument: place strip, barrel-yard proof, spec numbers, tanker/acid tank, lab, people, quote.
Quality, Manufacturing, LABSA 90% and Contact pageheads now open on different plant photographs under the same navy wash.

issues.problem: About pagehead crops plant-team-1400.webp to roof/sky; under the navy wash it reads as the old solid slab.
issues.fix: Set .pagehead--team background-position to 50% 62% so the workers and tanker cab read through the wash. Lighten overlay stops to .72/.58/.68.

issues.problem: CSS still sets .mcol:nth-child(2){display:none} below 1024px, so the yard/worker pane is gone on tablet and mobile.
issues.fix: Delete display:none on .mcol:nth-child(2). At 375px stack all three .mcol. At 768–1023px use a 3-column grid.

issues.problem: Open menu shows nav links over a ghost of the hero headline.
issues.fix: Set .nav ul background to #fff and min-height to cover the hero title block.

reference_fidelity.evidence: Signature move is there: original tanks/tanker/drums skyline on a navy band; Vico green is not imported. Inner pageheads now use distinct photos except About which still matches the old slab. Skyline is a full-width watermark at opacity .12 under the link row.
strengths: Footer uses original Gundlav tanks/tanker/drums on navy, not Vico cranes or teal.
Quality, Manufacturing, LABSA 90% and Contact pageheads are photo-backed navy washes.
Beyond the footer reference the site keeps industrial density: mosaic cuts, spec table, named plot and tanker.

issues.problem: About still reads as the old solid navy slab because the team photo is cropped to building/sky.
Skyline is opacity .12, full width, and the link row sits on the tanks.
issues.fix: Raise footer::after opacity from .12 to .28–.35, align left/bottom, keep type in a padding-bottom: 96px clear band.
